The model preference was designed to live in browser `localStorage`, keyed by the signed-in user—not in a particular session or worktree. That lets the choice survive refreshes and carry over to new worktrees and sessions. Local mode uses a separate local scope.

A model change is remembered only after the session’s model update succeeds. Pending or failed changes do not overwrite the saved choice, and simply opening an older session does not change it.

For existing browsers with no saved preference, the first successful load of the current session seeds it from that session’s already-persisted model. This happens only if no preference exists, so later navigation won’t overwrite a saved choice. If there’s still no valid preference, the app keeps using the existing default.
